content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Administrative Departments Student Services Student Management Student Management Student management supports you from the start of your studies to graduation. We take care of applications, admissions, examination matters and certificates. *** On 15 January 2026, the afternoon consultation hours from 12:30 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. will be cancelled. *** Responsibilities Here you can find out what tasks the Student Management team is responsible for and what the Examination Board for your degree programme is responsible for. Responsibilities of the Examination Board Recognition of academic achievements and examination results Written objections to performance assessments Compensation for disadvantages Admission to final examinations Changes to the title and topic of final theses, return of the topic and extension of the processing time Student management responsibilities Processing applications for leave of absence, part-time study or de-registration, as well as change notifications Final processing of the recognition of academic achievements and examination results in the event of a change of degree programme or university, interruption of studies or delay in studies Re-registration for each new semester Examination registration Repeatability of academic and examination achievements Grades, performance certificates, certificates and final certificates Exmatriculation ex officio Issuing duplicates, certifying and legalising certificates Pre-certification of documents for use abroad Contact form The best way to contact us is via our contact form . Please note: For certificates and authentications , please use this form exclusively. Consultation hours You are welcome to come to the open personal consultation hours. During this time, you can simply drop by with your concerns without an appointment. Students from all departments Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday: 9:00 to 11:30 a.m. and 12:30 to 3:00 p.m. Treskowallee Campus, Building A, Room 040 International applicants and students Tuesday: 9:00 to 11:30 a.m. and 12:30 to 3:00 p.m. Treskowallee Campus, Building A, Room 039 Students of the Division of Continuing Education (ZbwS) Tuesday: 9:00 to 11:30 a.m. and 1:00 to 3:00 p.m. Thursday: 9:00 to 11:30 and by appointment Treskowallee Campus, Building A, Room 038 Telephone For clarification of complicated individual cases.
